verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own docs show it can create sharing links for files and folders (driveItems) and share content externally with partners or clients, which is the base of a lightweight data room. Nothing in the evidence shows view-only link types, download blocking, or per-viewer access visibility; the one 'analytics' mention is a generic platform feature, not diligence access tracking. Missing for 10: documented view-only link permissions, download controls, access/viewer visibility or audit for shared folders, and hands-on corroboration of a data-room workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence

citations.quote: The createLink action creates a new sharing link if the specified link type doesn't already exist for the calling application.
External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive allows users to share content with people outside your organization, such as partners, vendors, clients, or customers.
Users can share links to files, copy or move files to team drives
